verdict.rationale: Board power is a fair axis for a discrete GPU, but nothing in the evidence pack gives the RTX 5080's TDP/TGP, power connector requirements, recommended PSU, or cooling guidance. The pack covers DLSS, AI features, CUDA tooling, and general performance reviews instead. The one community note on performance-per-watt and temperatures concerns the 4080 Super, not this card's published specs, so it earns no credit.
